# Evolv Technology Strengthens its Presence in North American Professional Soccer with Renewal of St. Louis CITY SC Subscription Agreement


October 06, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_0af74e988c62c2af55f4c6dc233ea29d/evolvtechnology/news/2026-10-06_Evolv_Technology_Strengthens_its_Presence_in_293.pdf)


*Multi-year renewal of Evolv Express® includes upgrade to all Gen2 hardware*


WALTHAM, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Evolv Technologies Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: EVLV), a leading security technology company pioneering AI-powered solutions designed to create safer experiences, today announced that Major League Soccer team,[St. Louis CITY SC](https://www.stlcitysc.com/) , has entered a multi-year renewal agreement for[Evolv Express®](https://evolv.com/concealed-weapons-detection/express/) , the company’s people-screening solution. Express has been in use at[Energizer Park](https://www.stlcitysc.com/stadium/) , the team’s 22,423-seat home stadium, since its opening in 2023. Nearly two million people have been screened to date using Evolv Express at CITY SC matches and community events.


The renewal, which maintains Evolv’s status as CITY SC’s “Official Fan Screening Partner,” has updated the Express fleet to all Gen2 hardware, which went live in April. Evolv Express uses advanced sensor technology and AI to detect concealed threats and identify the person and location of the potential threat, while allowing people to move through checkpoints at their natural walking pace. The system is designed to screen visitors effectively while helping minimize congestion and disruption to traffic flow at entry points. The new Gen2 hardware adds enhanced mobility, improved camera resolution, and other features to the equipment fleet. Gen2 has progressively been rolling out across North American sports facilities as existing Evolv customers renew, and new teams and venues join Evolv’s roster.


“Since our inaugural season, our partnership with Evolv has helped enhance our fan experience while not compromising safety,” said Matt Sebek, Chief Experience Officer, St. Louis CITY SC. “It’s our goal to make Energizer Park one of the most innovative and efficient stadiums in MLS. Extending our relationship with Evolv and updating our Express units to the latest hardware helps us continue to deliver an efficient arrival experience for our fans and staff from the moment they enter the stadium.”


“CITY SC is another in a growing list of teams and venues that have elected to renew and extend their Express subscription agreement far ahead of the end of the initial term,” said John Baier, Evolv Vice President of Sports & Entertainment. “We’re grateful for the vote of confidence that these renewals illustrate and appreciate the opportunity to deliver our latest product and enhanced fan arrival experience to hundreds of thousands of St. Louis soccer fans each season.”


The CITY SC renewal is further evidence of Evolv’s strong and stable position in American professional soccer. With other recent additions in MLS, Evolv serves 15+ professional soccer teams. These soccer teams join many other professional sports teams and venues around the world on the Evolv sports and entertainment customer list.


**About St. Louis CITY SC**


St. Louis CITY SC, one of the few majority female-led ownership groups in all of professional sports, is Major League Soccer’s 28th expansion team and plays at Energizer Park, an STLMade 22,500-seat world-class soccer-specific stadium. Energizer Park is part of a new world-class stadium district, which includes a practice facility, team store and team headquarters all within the same 30+ acre urban campus in downtown St. Louis to help further the region’s continued growth and revitalization. St. Louis CITY SC’s vision is to be an exceptional club and neighbor that brings people together through the power of sports.


**About Evolv Technology**


Evolv (NASDAQ: EVLV) is designed to transform human security by helping organizations detect potential threats, mitigate risk, and enhance safety using AI-powered security solutions with robust insights. Our technology has helped to create efficient and positive security screening experiences for the world’s most iconic venues and companies as well as schools, hospitals, and public spaces. Evolv’s mission is to create a safer world to live, work, learn, and play. Evolv’s advanced systems have scanned more than 4.5 billion people since 2019. Evolv Express® and Evolv eXpedite™ have been awarded the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) SAFETY Act Designation as a Qualified Anti-Terrorism Technology (QATT). Evolv and its products have been awarded numerous awards which can be viewed on our[Certifications and Awards](https://evolv.com/certifications-and-awards/) web page. Evolv®, Evolv Express®, Evolv Insights®, and Evolv eXpedite™ are registered trademarks or trademarks of Evolv Technologies, Inc. in the United States and other jurisdictions. For more information, visit[evolv.com](https://evolv.com/) .
